steps.name: DESeq2 LRT for the condition:time interaction
caveats: With 3 replicates per cell the interaction term has low power: it is a difference of two differences, so its standard error exceeds that of a main effect at the same replicate count. A gene absent from the interaction list is NOT shown to behave identically in both arms

Gene-level counts without tximport length offsets: a gene whose isoform usage shifts can appear differentially expressed

The LRT against the reduced model is precisely the research question: it removes the shared time trend and the constant condition offset. Keep the DESeq2 Cook's-distance outlier behaviour on (with 3 replicates per cell it sets p to NA rather than replacing counts)
Use apeglm for shrinkage of a single named coefficient; use ashr where the reported effect is a contrast that is not one model coefficient
Report the intersection of DESeq2 and edgeR, not the union

constraints: Use the same alpha (0.05) and BH adjustment for the simple effects as for the interaction test
Rank genes and draw plots on the shrunken log2 fold change, never on the unshrunken value alone; keep p-values from the unshrunken fit
Name the reference level of condition and of time beside every table

steps.name: Preranked GSEA on the interaction ranking

A single ranking metric collapses a four-time-point interaction into one number; sets driven by early-only or transient responses may be missed
steps.context: Reference data needed: human hallmark gene sets and human GO biological process gene sets — both are present in the reference store for Homo sapiens as symbol GMTs (MSigDB 2026.1). The procedure names Reactome as the second collection after hallmark, but no Reactome collection is provisioned here; GO BP substitutes and the step must state the substitution and the collection version. Input is the full tested gene list from the interaction test (~12000 genes before filtering), not a thresholded list.
steps.question: Which hallmark and GO biological processes are coordinately enriched among the genes whose time course differs between the treated and control arms?

grounding.reason: Preranked fgsea on the full tested list against hallmark first (R-0107, R-0048). R-0108 is disputed: the plan chooses the test statistic (LRT statistic, signed by the t3 interaction coefficient) over the signed p-value and the shrunken fold change, per R-0099. R-0098 names Reactome as the second collection but none is provisioned, so GO BP substitutes and the step reports it.

constraints: Universe = the genes tested in T1S2, not the whole annotation
Do not run an over-representation test on the significant gene list if it holds fewer than ~50 genes; use the ranked method on the full list and state the size of the significant list
BH adjustment on the gene set p-values
If either GMT collection is absent at run time, report the absence and continue with whichever human collection is present, rather than substituting a non-human collection

Hallmark run is reported first, GO BP second, each with the collection name and version (MSigDB 2026.1, human symbols)

Gene set size window 15-500 applied AFTER intersecting each set with the tested genes; the window is reported
Identifier mapping is reported with the share of tested genes that failed to map and the count of many-to-many mappings dropped; no mixing of identifier spaces between list and universe
Redundant significant sets are collapsed and one representative per group is reported, full table kept as a supplement
Leading-edge genes are listed per significant set with their gene-level statistic, and overlaps between leading edges are marked
A random seed is set and recorded for the permutation-based p-values

steps.name: Consolidated interaction report
caveats: If the interaction list is empty or very small, the correct conclusion is that this design lacks the power to resolve treatment-specific time profiles at 12000 genes and 3 replicates per cell — not that no such genes exist
steps.context: Consolidates T1S2, T1S3 and T2S1 into one document. grounding.reason: Report contents follow the returned report step: interaction plus simple effects (R-0092), power statement at 3 replicates (R-0094), two-method overlap (R-0042), trajectory clusters (R-0091), fit diagnostics (R-0087) and the reproducibility record (R-0086).

constraints: Do not present exploratory trajectory clusters or enrichment hits as established mechanism
Do not restate a looser threshold anywhere; alpha stays at 0.05 throughout
State the number of significant interaction genes plainly, including if it is zero or near zero — that is a valid and informative result for this design
steps.description: Assemble the final report: design and both reference levels, method and package versions, thresholds, number of genes tested after filtering and number significant per test; MA plot and dispersion plot as fit diagnostics; the p-value histogram; the combined table of simple effects and interaction contrast with unshrunken log2FC, shrunken log2FC and lfcSE; the trajectory clusters; the DESeq2/edgeR overlap with the intersection named as high-confidence; the GSEA results with collection versions, ranking metric, universe and size window, and leading-edge genes per set; an explicit power statement for 3 replicates per cell; and a reproducibility record (sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, collection versions).

MA plot and dispersion plot appear before the gene tables, each with a sentence on what it shows
Gene tables carry unshrunken log2FC, shrunken log2FC and lfcSE, with the shrinkage estimator named in the header; ranking uses the shrunken value
Simple effects at each time point and the interaction contrast appear side by side with reference levels named
Trajectory clusters are reported with mean profiles, member counts and the clustering method
DESeq2 and edgeR significant counts and their intersection are reported; the union is not presented as the result
Enrichment section reports database and version, ranking metric, universe, size window, tool version, multiple-testing method, leading-edge genes per significant set, and the method-dependence caveat

plan.title: Treatment x time interaction DE across t0-t3
plan.analytical_narrative:
The research question — which genes change over the four time points in a treatment-specific way, beyond the shared time trend — is exactly the condition:time interaction of the 2 x 4 design in /eval-four-arms-with-timecourse-2x4-n3-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (24 rows, columns condition, time, time_hours). Note the counts matrix is 12000 genes x 25 columns (gene symbol column + 24 sample columns), so the first column is the gene symbol and the sample columns must be matched by name to the metadata rows before anything else runs; any mismatch is a hard stop, not something to fix by position.

The design has 2 conditions x 4 time points x 3 replicates = 24 samples, one cell of 3 replicates per condition-time combination. Because the interaction spans three coefficients (time has four levels), a Wald test on a single coefficient does not answer the question. The primary test is therefore the DESeq2 likelihood ratio test of the full model ~ condition + time + condition:time against the reduced ~ condition + time, which removes exactly the shared time trend and the constant condition offset and asks whether the time profile differs between the two arms — whatever its shape. This is the one deviation from the returned procedure's default (`test = interaction`, a Wald test on one coefficient); it is the procedure's own named alternative for a time course with three or more time points, and the knowledge check returned it as a warning rather than a violation. The choice is stated in the step.

Everything upstream is a means to that test: sample structure QC on the blind VST (does the primary axis separate time, condition, or a replicate?), a minimal 10-count pre-filter so independent filtering does the rest, and median-of-ratios size factors estimated inside the model — the counts are raw integers from salmon and must not be pre-scaled. Because the counts are already a gene-level integer matrix rather than salmon quant directories, the tximport length-offset route is unavailable; the step must say so, since a change in isoform usage can then masquerade as a change in gene expression.

With three replicates per cell the interaction term is the least powerful test in the design — its standard error is that of a difference of differences. The plan does not compensate with a looser threshold. It keeps alpha at 0.05 and instead surrounds the interaction list with what makes it interpretable: the per-time-point simple effects (treated vs control at each of t0, t1, t2, t3) at the same threshold, an edgeR quasi-likelihood test of the same interaction terms as a second method with the intersection reported as the high-confidence set, and trajectory clustering of the significant genes, because one fold change cannot describe a gene whose profile differs. Absence from the interaction list is explicitly not evidence of a shared trend.

Enrichment runs preranked on the full tested list rather than on a thresholded one, since a three-replicate interaction test is unlikely to yield 50 significant genes. Human hallmark and GO gene sets are present in the reference store; Reactome, which the procedure names as the second collection, is not, so the plan substitutes GO BP and says so.

steps.method: Blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes
Keep genes with >=10 counts in at least 3 samples (smallest cell size)
Median-of-ratios size factors inside the model
~ condition + time + condition:time with explicit reference levels (condition reference = control arm, time reference = t0)
DESeq2 likelihood ratio test, full ~ condition + time + condition:time vs reduced ~ condition + time; edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same interaction terms as a robustness check
apeglm shrinkage of individual condition:time coefficients; ashr where the reported effect is a contrast rather than one coefficient
Benjamini-Hochberg with independent filtering, p-value histogram inspected before adjustment
fgsea preranked GSEA ranked by the DESeq2 LRT statistic (signed by the t3 interaction coefficient), MSigDB Hallmark then GO BP
Interaction contrast plus simple effects, trajectory clusters, MA and dispersion plots, power statement, reproducibility record

steps.name: Preranked GSEA on the interaction ranking
steps.question: Which hallmark and GO biological processes are coordinately enriched among the genes whose time course differs between the treated and control arms?
steps.description: Run fgsea preranked over ALL tested genes from T1S2, ranked by the DESeq2 LRT statistic signed by the direction of the late-time interaction coefficient (condition:time t3 shrunken log2FC), against the human MSigDB hallmark collection first and the human GO biological process collection second. Map gene symbols to the collection identifier space with the human organism annotation package, report the unmapped share, restrict sets to 15-500 genes among the tested genes, collapse redundant significant sets, and report the leading-edge genes of each significant set with their gene-level statistics.
steps.context: Reference data needed: human hallmark gene sets and human GO biological process gene sets — both are present in the reference store for Homo sapiens as symbol GMTs (MSigDB 2026.1). The procedure names Reactome as the second collection after hallmark, but no Reactome collection is provisioned here; GO BP substitutes and the step must state the substitution and the collection version. Input is the full tested gene list from the interaction test (~12000 genes before filtering), not a thresholded list.
acceptance_criteria: fgsea is run on the FULL ranked list of tested genes, never on a thresholded subset

Ranking metric is the LRT statistic signed by the direction of the t3 interaction coefficient; the choice is stated explicitly in the output, along with why an unshrunken fold change and a tie-prone signed p-value were rejected
Hallmark run is reported first, GO BP second, each with the collection name and version (MSigDB 2026.1, human symbols)
The absence of a Reactome collection in the reference store is stated, with GO BP named as the substitute
Gene set size window 15-500 applied AFTER intersecting each set with the tested genes; the window is reported
Identifier mapping is reported with the share of tested genes that failed to map and the count of many-to-many mappings dropped; no mixing of identifier spaces between list and universe
Redundant significant sets are collapsed and one representative per group is reported, full table kept as a supplement
Leading-edge genes are listed per significant set with their gene-level statistic, and overlaps between leading edges are marked
A random seed is set and recorded for the permutation-based p-values
constraints: Universe = the genes tested in T1S2, not the whole annotation
Do not run an over-representation test on the significant gene list if it holds fewer than ~50 genes; use the ranked method on the full list and state the size of the significant list
BH adjustment on the gene set p-values
If either GMT collection is absent at run time, report the absence and continue with whichever human collection is present, rather than substituting a non-human collection
caveats: Enrichment results are method-dependent: a ranked test and an over-representation test on the same data give different lists. Present a set as a hypothesis, not a finding
GO BP is a nested hierarchy — parent and child sets share members, so significant hits arrive in correlated blocks and must be collapsed before any count is reported
A single ranking metric collapses a four-time-point interaction into one number; sets driven by early-only or transient responses may be missed

grounding.reason: Preranked fgsea on the full tested list against hallmark first (R-0107, R-0048). R-0108 is disputed: the plan chooses the test statistic (LRT statistic, signed by the t3 interaction coefficient) over the signed p-value and the shrunken fold change, per R-0099. R-0098 names Reactome as the second collection but none is provisioned, so GO BP substitutes and the step reports it.

steps.name: Consolidated interaction report
steps.question: What is the evidence, with its stated power limits, that specific genes and pathways respond to treatment in a time-dependent way across t0-t3?
steps.description: Assemble the final report: design and both reference levels, method and package versions, thresholds, number of genes tested after filtering and number significant per test; MA plot and dispersion plot as fit diagnostics; the p-value histogram; the combined table of simple effects and interaction contrast with unshrunken log2FC, shrunken log2FC and lfcSE; the trajectory clusters; the DESeq2/edgeR overlap with the intersection named as high-confidence; the GSEA results with collection versions, ranking metric, universe and size window, and leading-edge genes per set; an explicit power statement for 3 replicates per cell; and a reproducibility record (sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, collection versions).
steps.context: Consolidates T1S2, T1S3 and T2S1 into one document. The central caution to carry through: at 3 replicates per condition-time cell the interaction test recovers only a minority of true effects, so the gene list is a lower bound and absence from it is not evidence of a shared time trend.
acceptance_criteria: Report states the method, every package version, the design formula ~ condition + time + condition:time, the reduced model, both reference levels, the thresholds, the number of genes tested and the number significant per test
MA plot and dispersion plot appear before the gene tables, each with a sentence on what it shows
Gene tables carry unshrunken log2FC, shrunken log2FC and lfcSE, with the shrinkage estimator named in the header; ranking uses the shrunken value
Simple effects at each time point and the interaction contrast appear side by side with reference levels named
Trajectory clusters are reported with mean profiles, member counts and the clustering method
DESeq2 and edgeR significant counts and their intersection are reported; the union is not presented as the result
Enrichment section reports database and version, ranking metric, universe, size window, tool version, multiple-testing method, leading-edge genes per significant set, and the method-dependence caveat

An explicit power statement for 3 replicates per condition-time cell precedes the gene tables, stating that an absent gene is not shown to be unchanged and that the interaction term is the least powerful test in this design
Reproducibility record (sessionInfo, random seeds, package versions, gene set collection versions) is stored with the results
constraints: Do not present exploratory trajectory clusters or enrichment hits as established mechanism
Do not restate a looser threshold anywhere; alpha stays at 0.05 throughout
State the number of significant interaction genes plainly, including if it is zero or near zero — that is a valid and informative result for this design
caveats: If the interaction list is empty or very small, the correct conclusion is that this design lacks the power to resolve treatment-specific time profiles at 12000 genes and 3 replicates per cell — not that no such genes exist

grounding.reason: Report contents follow the returned report step: interaction plus simple effects (R-0092), power statement at 3 replicates (R-0094), two-method overlap (R-0042), trajectory clusters (R-0091), fit diagnostics (R-0087) and the reproducibility record (R-0086).
